strategies.description: Long while SMA(fast) of closes is above SMA(slow), otherwise flat.
strategies.name: Trend following (SMA crossover)
strategies.signal_timing: computed from bars up to and including the close of day t; the resulting order fills at the open of day t+1
strategies.warmup_rule: slow bars: SMA(slow) needs slow closes

strategies.description: z = (close - rolling mean) / rolling std over lookback closes. Enter long when z < -entry_z, exit when z >= 0.
strategies.name: Mean reversion (z-score)
strategies.signal_timing: computed from bars up to and including the close of day t; the resulting order fills at the open of day t+1
strategies.warmup_rule: lookback bars: rolling mean and std need lookback closes

strategies.description: Enter long when close > highest high of the previous N bars + k * ATR(N) of the previous N bars. Exit when close < lowest low of the previous N // 2 bars.
strategies.name: Volatility breakout
strategies.signal_timing: computed from bars up to and including the close of day t; the resulting order fills at the open of day t+1
strategies.warmup_rule: N + 1 bars: channel and ATR use the N bars before the signal bar
